text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooh...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Who was it...!
Who was the one that said to wait and see...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna...! Can she even shatter jinxes...?
She's completely off the charts...!
choice_data_list: (She changed the whole venue's atmosphere in an instant...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ha.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Looks like you're finally awake."

With her powerful running, Gentildonna
successfully opened the eyes of skeptical fans.

—However... because of that very power,
she was confronted with a new question.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna-san, you're taking the Tiara route, right?
I'm looking forward to it even more now!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
By the way... judging by today's run,
I felt you'd be fully capable of competing
on the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Why the Tiara route
instead of the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You.
What publication are you with?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, I'm with the Passion Sports Newspaper, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The biggest name in the industry, aren't you?
Then I trust your publication will publicize this responsibly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: From here on out, let's have no more foolish questions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Uh—

The reporter turns a troubled gaze toward me.
Gentildonna remains silent.
Which means... I have permission to answer for her.
choice_data_list: Strength isn't defined by distance aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Walking that path is not what makes one strong.
Nor does not walking it make one weak.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The path I walk—the path walked by the strong—
that is the only right path."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I am sure all of you are well aware
of the Tiara's beauty.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is the proof of an empowered lady.
Its brilliance is a beauteous pride...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Please, take a moment to think upon all those who have walked this path before you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Quite
resilient, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I intend to bestow
a brand-new power upon the radiance of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "A power that only I can bestow, now and forever..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: A-And that power is...!
choice_data_list: I will definitely show you in the not-too-distant future.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho.
Please look forward to that day.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—*pant*... *pant*...!
*pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
There you are, Big Sis~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's take a bath already!
Today, we have a vanilla bath bomb and—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, go on ahead without me.
Big Sis hasn't gotten in enough running yet.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
Big sis~?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still... I have to do it.
I can't just stay like this and stand—at the very top.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
My big sister is the best of all!
She's super strong and so cool♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, a tiara would toootally suit you,
Onee-chan, don't you think~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Well.
I mean, she's... big sis, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Leave it to me.
As long as I can surpass that person...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'll show both of you.
...Big Sis wearing the Tiara!

Our next target race is finally the first crown of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho—
where the flowers come together to bloom and clash.
